evals.prompt: Run a read-only security assessment of my Amazon SageMaker setup in us-east-1 and give me a severity-rated findings report.
evals.expected_output: A complete findings report in the final response covering SM-01..SM-25 for us-east-1, with status, severity and verifiability per check. Against the live account: SM-01 Failed (notebook sogai-week-5-notebook has DirectInternetAccess=Enabled; domain is PublicInternetOnly), SM-09 Failed (RootAccess=Enabled), SM-10 Failed (notebook has no SubnetId), SM-11 Failed (model djl-inference-2026-02-13-17-57-59-540 has EnableNetworkIsolation=false), SM-04 Passed (GuardDuty detector ENABLED), SM-17 Failed (processing job skilleval-sm17-noKms has no VolumeKmsKeyId), SM-22 Failed for group skilleval-sm22-auto (approved without any manual-approval transition) while skilleval-sm22-manual is cited as gated, and SM-12/SM-23 N/A (no endpoints). The assessment is read-only.
assertions: The final response contains the findings report itself, not only a plan or progress update
SM-01, SM-09, SM-10 and SM-11 are reported as Failed, citing the notebook and model by name
SM-04 is reported as Passed
SM-22 is Failed for skilleval-sm22-auto and does not call skilleval-sm22-manual auto-approved
SM-12 and SM-23 are N/A because there are no endpoints

assertions.text: Check IDs use the SM-NN form
Each finding has a Verifiability classification

assertions: SM-08 and SM-22 are reported as N/A

evals.prompt: Run a read-only security assessment of my Amazon Bedrock guardrails and model-invocation logging.
Assess our Bedrock AgentCore runtimes and gateways for VPC and encryption security.
My sagemaker:CreateTrainingJob call is returning AccessDenied - trace which IAM hop is blocking it.
Help me resize an EC2 instance to reduce cost.
Are model approvals in my SageMaker Model Registry in us-east-1 actually gated by manual review, or are versions being auto-approved?
evals.expected_output: Live account: SM-22 reads the Approval lineage actions (ListActions). skilleval-sm22-manual version 1 went PendingManualApproval then Approved, so it is gated; skilleval-sm22-auto version 1 was Approved with no manual-approval transition, so it is flagged as auto-approval. The check never infers auto-approval from current status alone.
assertions: skilleval-sm22-auto is flagged as auto-approved
skilleval-sm22-manual is not called auto-approved and its PendingManualApproval to Approved transition is cited

assertions.text: The agent uses the Approval lineage actions
The finding is labelled SM-22 with a Verifiability classification
